name: intrusion_signal_guard
description: Port of ole-eval code/qwen_vm/app_scenarios/intrusion_signal_guard. Verdict ladder mirrors Python _decide: known_signature OR strong>=2 OR (strong>=1 AND weak>=2) -> block; strong==1 OR weak>=2 -> challenge; weak==1 -> monitor; else allow. Actions: block=quarantine_proposal, challenge=step_up_mfa, monitor=watch, allow=none. No real blocking/quarantine side effect.

known_signature.instructions: Does the request match a known signature (sql_injection / path_traversal / log4j_injection / shellshock, or sqlmap/nikto/masscan/zgrab user-agent)?

failed_login_velocity.instructions: Strong signal: >=5 failed logins in the last 600s?

port_scan_window.instructions: Strong signal: >=20 unique ports probed in the last 60s?

impossible_travel.instructions: Strong signal: country changed with 0 <= delta <= 1800s?

unusual_country.instructions: Weak signal: current country outside the user's usual countries?

off_hours_access.instructions: Weak signal: event clock hour outside 07:00-20:00?

intrusion_verdict.instructions: Which verdict does the signal combination imply? block: signature OR strong>=2 OR (strong>=1 AND weak>=2). challenge: strong==1 OR weak>=2. monitor: weak==1. allow: none.

criteria.challenge: one strong, or two weak, or strong+weak<2; action=step_up_mfa
criteria.block: signature, or >=2 strong, or >=1 strong and >=2 weak; action=quarantine_proposal
